message_1_subject: Exec roundtable: presence rotations & breakout slot reconciliation
message_1_body:
Hi Elena / Joe —

Thanks again for agreeing to host the exec roundtable with your leadership team on May 4. To make the onsite day tight and high-value we want to confirm presence rotations (who leads the room vs. virtual attendees) and finalize breakout assignments so we can lock calendar invites and catering counts.

Quick asks: 
- Please confirm the final attendee roster and which two leaders will be in-person at 9:00–11:30 PT vs. remote.
- Callout any attendees who need dial-in only or have AV restrictions (e.g., can’t be on camera).
- Confirm whether you want two 45-min breakout rooms or three 30-min breakouts — we recommended two 45s for deeper discussion.

We attached a working roster and the venue floorplan. Internal note: Monica/Ben — once Elena confirms, can you map breakout leads to rooms and send the updated ICS blocks? We should hold the rooms and AV tech now (venue requires final counts 14 days in advance).

High level schedule suggestion (local PT):
- 08:30 — light breakfast / check-in
- 09:00 — exec roundtable (in-person + livestream)
- 11:30 — break / lunch
- 13:00 — breakout sessions (45m each x2)
- 15:00 — synthesis & next steps

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply so we can finalize travel and badge access.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Exec_Roundtable_Roster_v3.xlsx, Venue_Floorplan.pdf
message_2_subject: Re: Exec roundtable: presence rotations & breakout slot reconciliation
message_2_body:
Thanks Rishi — quick answers below and attaching our internal attendee matrix for clarity.

Attendee notes:
- In-person leaders at HQ (San Francisco): Elena Martinez, Joe Park — will be present 09:00–12:00 PT.
- Remote: Dr. Sarah Lin (CTO), Marcus Chen (Head of Ops) — both remote, will join via Zoom; Marcus has limited camera time.
- Dial-in only: Karen Yu (Board observer) — will not be on video.

Breakouts: we prefer two 45-min breakouts to go deeper. Proposed breakout themes: 1) Integration & Data Flows, 2) Cost/Performance & Roadmap.

Counts: expected 18 attendees in-person total (including 4 Redwood folks). Venue booking: please hold rooms for 20.

I'll confirm travel windows for our field team by EOD tomorrow. For the roster I attached a short version — note we have two VIPs who require separate check-in (Karen & Dr. Lin) — Karen will be phone-only.

Elena
VP, Platform Partnerships | Orbis Health

message_3_subject: Re: Exec roundtable: presence rotations & breakout slot reconciliation
message_3_body:
Thanks Elena — this is great and clean. A few operational items I’ll take action on: 

- I’ll reserve the main ballroom + two breakout rooms for 08:00–16:30 PT and add AV on a dedicated line for the livestream.
- Ben — can you be breakout lead for Integration & Data Flows? Marissa, can you lead Cost/Performance & Roadmap? Mark each breakout lead as hybrid facilitator (in-person + remote handoff).
- I’ll send ICS invites for: main session (09:00–11:30), lunch (11:30–13:00), breakout A (13:00–13:45), breakout B (14:00–14:45), synthesis (15:00–15:30).

Travel windows: Our preliminary travel plan for Redwood attendees is May 3 (arrive evening) to May 5 (depart late). Elena — if your field team needs hotel nights outside that window, flag now. Also, do we want a pre-event 30-min dry run for AV and the livestream team on May 3 at 16:00 PT? I recommend yes.

Attachments referenced: Exec_Roundtable_Roster_v3.xlsx (updated with breakout leads) — I’ll push v4 after Ben/Marissa confirm. Venue_Floorplan.pdf included for room assignments.
